name: Speckle Project
description: A Powerhouse mirror of one Speckle project. Holds its models, every observed revision pinned by its immutable referencedObject hash, the masses read straight off the object graph per Speckle type, and an element-level change log between consecutive revisions. Every write is an upsert keyed on the Speckle id, so re-syncing is idempotent and the operation history stays a truthful record of when each fact arrived.

global.schema:
type SpeckleProjectState {
    serverUrl: URL
    projectId: String
    name: String
    description: String
    visibility: String
    syncedAt: DateTime
    models: [SpeckleModel!]!
    revisions: [Revision!]!
    changes: [ChangeEntry!]!
}

type SpeckleModel {
    id: OID!
    speckleModelId: String!
    name: String!
    displayName: String
    updatedAt: DateTime
    latestVersionId: String
    versionCount: Int!
}

type Revision {
    id: OID!
    speckleModelId: String!
    modelName: String
    versionId: String!
    referencedObject: String!
    message: String
    sourceApplication: String
    authorName: String
    createdAt: DateTime
    previewUrl: URL
    objectCount: Int!
    truncated: Boolean!
    categories: [CategoryTotal!]!
    syncedAt: DateTime!
}

type CategoryTotal {
    id: OID!
    speckleType: String!
    objectCount: Int!
    unit: String
    volume: Float
    area: Float
    length: Float
}

type ChangeEntry {
    id: OID!
    speckleModelId: String!
    fromVersionId: String
    toVersionId: String!
    detectedAt: DateTime!
    addedCount: Int!
    removedCount: Int!
    modifiedCount: Int!
    touchedElements: [TouchedElement!]!
    deltas: [CategoryDelta!]!
}

"""
One element a revision touched, carrying the identity that survives edits.

A Speckle object id is a content hash, so it changes whenever the element does.
`identity` is the authoring tool's own element id where it has one, which is what
makes it possible to say that the same wall was modified in four revisions.
"""
type TouchedElement {
    id: OID!
    identity: String!
    objectId: String!
    speckleType: String!
    kind: ChangeKind!
}

enum ChangeKind {
    ADDED
    MODIFIED
    REMOVED
}

type CategoryDelta {
    id: OID!
    speckleType: String!
    unit: String
    countBefore: Int!
    countAfter: Int!
    volumeBefore: Float
    volumeAfter: Float
    areaBefore: Float
    areaAfter: Float
}
global.initialValue:
{
    "serverUrl": null,
    "projectId": null,
    "name": null,
    "description": null,
    "visibility": null,
    "syncedAt": null,
    "models": [],
    "revisions": [],
    "changes": []
}

modules.name: identity
modules.description: Which Speckle project this mirrors, and resetting the mirror

operations.name: SET_PROJECT_IDENTITY
operations.description: Records which Speckle project this document mirrors
operations.schema:
input SetProjectIdentityInput {
    serverUrl: URL!
    projectId: String!
    name: String
    description: String
    visibility: String
    syncedAt: DateTime!
}
operations.template: Records which Speckle project this document mirrors

errors.name: MissingProjectIdentityError
errors.description: The Speckle project id was blank or whitespace only

operations.name: CLEAR_SYNCED_DATA
operations.description: Empties the mirror so the next sync rebuilds it from scratch
operations.template: Empties the mirror so the next sync rebuilds it from scratch

operations.name: UPSERT_MODEL
operations.description: Adds or updates one Speckle model, keyed on its Speckle id
operations.schema:
input UpsertModelInput {

operations.template: Adds or updates one Speckle model, keyed on its Speckle id

operations.description: Removes a model and everything mirrored from it
operations.template: Removes a model and everything mirrored from it

errors.description: No model with that Speckle id is mirrored here

modules.name: revisions
modules.description: Observed versions with the masses read off their object graph

operations.name: UPSERT_REVISION
operations.description: Adds or refreshes one revision together with the masses read off its object graph
operations.schema:
input UpsertRevisionInput {
    id: OID!
    speckleModelId: String!
    modelName: String
    versionId: String!
    referencedObject: String!
    message: String
    sourceApplication: String
    authorName: String
    createdAt: DateTime
    previewUrl: URL
    objectCount: Int!
    truncated: Boolean
    syncedAt: DateTime!
    categories: [CategoryTotalInput!]!
}

input CategoryTotalInput {
    id: OID!
    speckleType: String!
    objectCount: Int!
    unit: String
    volume: Float
    area: Float
    length: Float
}
operations.template: Adds or refreshes one revision together with the masses read off its object graph

errors.name: IncompleteRevisionError
errors.description: versionId or referencedObject was blank or whitespace only

errors.name: UnknownRevisionModelError
errors.description: The revision's model has not been mirrored yet

operations.name: REMOVE_REVISION
operations.description: Drops a revision that no longer exists in Speckle
operations.template: Drops a revision that no longer exists in Speckle

errors.name: RevisionNotFoundError
errors.description: No revision with that version id is mirrored here

operations.name: RECORD_CHANGE
operations.description: Records which elements changed between two consecutive revisions and what that did to the masses
operations.schema:
input RecordChangeInput {
    id: OID!
    speckleModelId: String!
    fromVersionId: String
    toVersionId: String!
    detectedAt: DateTime!
    touchedElements: [TouchedElementInput!]
    deltas: [CategoryDeltaInput!]
}

input TouchedElementInput {
    id: OID!
    identity: String!
    objectId: String!
    speckleType: String!
    kind: ChangeKind!
}

input CategoryDeltaInput {
    id: OID!
    speckleType: String!
    unit: String
    countBefore: Int!
    countAfter: Int!
    volumeBefore: Float
    volumeAfter: Float
    areaBefore: Float
    areaAfter: Float
}
operations.template: Records which elements changed between two consecutive revisions and what that did to the masses

errors.name: ChangeRevisionUnknownError
